description: §8.1.2 (S456) — control for the one-statement rule: a single statement with a trailing `;` followed by a comment, a `;` inside a string literal, and two writes split into two `?{}`s inside a `transaction { }` block all compile clean.
rationale: §8.1.2: a `;` that is followed only by whitespace and comments ends the one statement; a `;` inside a literal, comment, quoted identifier or `${…}` slot is not a separator. The fix the diagnostic names (one `?{}` per statement; `transaction { }` for atomicity) compiles.
